_README: AUTHORED FROM THE CANONICAL SEMAPHORE STANDARD. NOT YET VERIFIED against an authoritative chart image. Before either platform trusts this file, validate every (left,right) pair against a reference chart (see _verification). The standard alphabet is well-established and consistent across sources, but the per-letter pairs below MUST be confirmed because a single transposed pair is a silent, hard-to-catch error.

_position_model.description: Each arm occupies one of 8 octant positions, 45 degrees apart. Position IDs and angles follow spec section 4.2 (signer's perspective, y-up, CCW from +x where +x points to the signer's LEFT). These are SINGLE-ARM directions, identical reference frame for both arms.
_position_model._position_note: Symbol keys (S, DR, R, ...) are human-readable aliases. The authoritative machine value is 'id'. The clock_note column is the bridge used to verify against printed charts, which conventionally describe positions in clock terms from the signer's own viewpoint.

_encoding_note: Each character lists the LEFT arm position id and RIGHT arm position id, both in the signer's-perspective frame defined above. The canonical alphabet is generated in 'circles': with one arm fixed, the other sweeps through positions. Pairs below follow that standard construction.

NUMERALS._note: the 'Numbers' / numeric sign; equals the 'J'-position family per standard; CONFIRM against chart

LETTERS._note: the 'J' / alphabetic sign returns from numeric to letter mode

REST._note: both arms straight down = space / rest / end

ERROR._note: 8+ rapid alternations / chart-specific; out of scope for v1 recognition, reserved

CANCEL._note: disregard previous signal; out of scope for v1 recognition, reserved

numeric_mode._note: In numeric mode the letter POSES A-J are reinterpreted as digits. Mapping per the international convention: A=1 .. I=9, K=0. (Some sources use J as the letters-shift, with K=0; CONFIRM the 0/J/K detail against the chart, this is the single most commonly misreported part of the standard.)

_label_order_note: This is the FROZEN output class order for the trained model and both platform exports. INDETERMINATE is the catch-all no-confident-pose class. Digits are NOT separate classes: they are produced by the decoder's numeric-mode reinterpretation of letter classes (spec 4.5), so they do not appear here.

must_do_before_use: Open an authoritative semaphore chart (e.g. Wikipedia 'Flag semaphore', a scouting/naval manual, or dCode's per-letter images).
For each letter A-Z, confirm the (left,right) octant pair matches the chart when read in the SIGNER'S perspective.
Confirm NUMERALS sign pose and the LETTERS/J relationship.
Confirm the digit map, especially which pose maps to 0 (J vs K) — this is the most error-prone detail.
Once confirmed, set status to VERIFIED and record the chart source + date here.
